description: Manage Datadog Logs indexes (filters, retention, exclusion filters, daily limits). Actions: list, get, update, reorder, get_order. Datadog identifies indexes by 'name', not 'id'. Note: create/delete are UI-only per Datadog and not supported through the API. Mutations (update, reorder) are blocked when the server is in read-only mode.

config.description: Index configuration (for update). Requires filter.query and numRetentionDays. Exclusion filters are forwarded unchanged.

index_names.description: Ordered index name list (required for reorder)

name.description: Index name (required for get/update). Datadog identifies indexes by name, not id.

verbose.description: Return full SDK payload alongside summary (default false)

name: logs_indexes
